attrs.quote: To scan the dependency versions selected for an environment, prefer a resolved lockfile.
attrs.note: Among them: go.mod, Cargo.lock, package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Pipfile.lock, requirements.txt, pom.xml, gradle.lockfile, composer.lock, Gemfile.lock, mix.lock, pubspec.lock, packages.lock.json, renv.lock.
